# Classified map contexts

Independently authored Java8 methods retain a collection element and classifier
key in Map<K,E> and Map<K,List<E>> results. A frozen observer checks incoming
references, scalar flags, exact provider selection, opaque actions, callback
order, partial effects, late results and casts. Source and SDK profiles compile
every recovered unit and compare original Signatures, roles, Exceptions and
reported helpers. No private application code or behavior is used.
